service_prices_amount_ck.name: service_prices_amount_ck
service_prices_amount_ck.value: ("service_prices"."status" = 'priced') = ("service_prices"."min_bani" is not null and "service_prices"."max_bani" is not null)

services_bookable_duration_ck.name: services_bookable_duration_ck
services_bookable_duration_ck.value: not "services"."bookable_online" or ("services"."base_duration_min" is not null and "services"."base_duration_min" + "services"."per_unit_duration_min" > 0)

closures_form_ck.name: closures_form_ck
closures_form_ck.value:
("closures"."date_from" is not null and "closures"."date_to" >= "closures"."date_from" and "closures"."starts_at" is null and "closures"."ends_at" is null)
        or ("closures"."date_from" is null and "closures"."date_to" is null and "closures"."starts_at" is not null and "closures"."ends_at" > "closures"."starts_at")

booking_items_price_ck.name: booking_items_price_ck
booking_items_price_ck.value: ("booking_items"."price_status" = 'priced') = ("booking_items"."unit_min_bani" is not null and "booking_items"."line_min_bani" is not null)

customers_name_ck.name: customers_name_ck
customers_name_ck.value: "customers"."full_name" is null or length("customers"."full_name") between 2 and 80

customers_anonymized_ck.name: customers_anonymized_ck
customers_anonymized_ck.value: ("customers"."anonymized_at" is null) = ("customers"."full_name" is not null and "customers"."phone_e164" is not null)
